issues.description: default_raise() sentinel pattern persists despite kw_only removing its original justification.
issues.detail: default_raise + field(default_factory=default_raise) was a workaround for pre-3.10 dataclasses lacking kw_only. Now that kw_only=True is universal, these fields are required by definition; the runtime-raising factory is dead scaffolding complecting 'required' with 'defaulted'. Drop default_factory entirely and let dataclass enforce required kwargs.

issues.description: Leftover < 3.10 compatibility comments and pragmas now mislead readers.
issues.detail: Comments like 'this is for < 3.10 compatibility' above TransactionEndpointRequest, and the default_raise docstring 'just for < 3.10 compatibility', remain after the version floor moved. The code now carries fossils that explain a constraint that no longer exists. Either delete the pattern or delete the comments; keeping both is incidental complexity disguised as history.

issues.description: kw_only_dataclass removal is the right decomplection but the replacement repeats decorator stacks verbatim.
issues.detail: Replacing kw_only_dataclass with @dataclass(frozen=True, kw_only=True) at ~15 sites is simple in the Hickey sense (one obvious meaning per site) but easy-not-simple to maintain if defaults drift. Consider whether @streamable could absorb the frozen+kw_only convention so the call sites describe data, not dataclass configuration.

issues.description: Install script python search list still encodes ordering policy as a flat string.
issues.detail: find_python iterates 'for V in 312 3.12 311 3.11 310 3.10 3'. The 3.9 entries were dropped, but the data-vs-code split is still complected: a preference list (data) lives inline in a loop (code). A small variable holding the supported versions, derived from one source of truth shared with CI, would make the policy a value rather than a shell literal.

issues.description: dnf search inside CI prep adds noise without affecting outcome.
issues.detail: The Amazon/Rocky prep now runs 'dnf search python3.12' before installing. Search output is a side effect on logs, not an input to any decision. It complects diagnostics with provisioning; either remove it or gate it behind a debug flag. Small, but the kind of incidental complexity that accretes in CI.

review.summary: The PR cleanly removes 3.9 version forks and is largely a decomplection win: sys.version_info branches and the kw_only_dataclass shim collapse into single statements, which is simple in the precise sense. The remaining incidental complexity is the default_raise/default_factory sentinel pattern, which was scaffolding for the very constraint this PR removes; it should go with it, along with the comments still pointing at < 3.10. The repeated @dataclass(frozen=True, kw_only=True) stack invites a follow-up to push that convention into @streamable so call sites describe data rather than dataclass mechanics. CI and install.sh changes are correct but carry small bits of noise (dnf search, inlined version preference list) worth tidying. Overall: SIMPLE-er than before, with a few EASY-NOT-SIMPLE fossils still visible.
